about.title: About Me
about.bio_1: I'm a digital media technology student at NJUPT, passionate about crafting digital experiences that blend aesthetics with functionality.
about.bio_2: From game development to desktop apps, from interactive installations to visual design — I thrive at the intersection of technology and art.
about.bio_3: In my spare time, I'm an electronic music producer, Blender enthusiast, graphic designer, and Bilibili content creator. I live by the motto: stay curious, stay tinkering.
